label: PD-T7-3 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a PD-T7-3 locus represented by DefenseFinder as a single-profile model, PD-T7-3__PD-T7-3, and experimentally linked to protection against T2, T4, T6, T5, SECphi17, T3, and T7 when expressed in E. coli.
observations: PD-T7-3 branch under phage defense system; distinct from the individual PD-T7-3 gene or protein, the DefenseFinder PD-T7-3__PD-T7-3 profile, the PD-T7-3 source key, broad phage protection outside a complete PD-T7-3 locus, RefSeq example loci without experimental validation, missing DefenseFinder article-registry rows, sibling PD-T7 systems, and other phage-defense systems.
